evidenceClass: GAME FACT (shipped assistant localization semantics; not numerical match weights)

possession_short_passing.text: Let's try to keep the ball longer with short passes. If we create opportunities that way, it might work out.
Our lead is looking good. Just keep to a short passing style to maintain possession.
Bad passing is affecting our possession percentage. Let's focus on short passes and try to keep the ball more.
We won the last game. Let's keep the ball and try to increase our possession. Let's avoid long balls.
Our passing is looking good. It was wise to play a short passing style.
Good job! Keep focusing on short passes to maintain control in the midfield.
We're not getting the ball to our attackers, and most long balls get intercepted. Shorter passes could help.
Long balls aren't working. Let's keep the ball on the ground with shorter passes.

direct_long_passing.text: Don't lose hope! There's still time to change the result. Consider attacking using a long passing style.
We need to hurry up! Try using more long passes in their half!
We have a low percentage for completed passes. How about trying long balls?
Our strategy with long passes is working really well! Their defenders don't stand a chance against our attackers.
This team is good. Maybe settle for a draw? Let's up defensive tactics and go for long balls and counter-attacks.
We need to change tactics due to a sent off player. Let's concentrate on defence and create opportunities from long balls and counter-attacks.
We're losing the midfield battle. Let's concentrate on defence and focus our attack through counter-attacks and long balls.

counter_attack_context.text: Our fast players could break past the opponent's defence if we decide to play counter-attacks.
They like ball possession. Invariably, their full-back is upfield. The right passes and counter-attacks may lead to a one-on-one situation.
We don't have a chance of controlling the game. We should focus on counter-attacks.
We can't expect to turn this one around. We're up against a very strong team. Maybe we can catch them on counter-attacks?
On paper, they're the favourites. We can out-think them. Let's sit back, defend and attack with counters.
What do you think about sitting back and troubling the opposition with counter-attacks? Let's try it!
The opponent knows how to stop our counter-attacks. We should try something else!
This result will get us through to the next phase. Let's play smart possession football, and pick them off with counter-attacks.

focus_passing_dynamic.text: We should identify our best performing players and focus on passing the ball to that part of the pitch.
They keep intercepting our passes to the flanks. Maybe we can try breaking down their defence through the middle.
Passing through the middle was a great choice, especially for our attackers!
We have a high pass completion percentage. Our passing through middle has been the perfect choice for this opponent.
We are ineffective when passing through the middle today. We should consider a more suitable tactic for this opponent.
Our attacks down the left flank are creating great opportunities. Let's keep it up!
We can't seem to complete enough passes when trying to play down the left flank.
Attacking down the flanks is paying off. Let's keep the ball, slow down the pace and save some energy.

midfield_and_targets.text: The opposition outnumbers us in midfield. As it stands, they have a better chance of keeping the ball.
We're losing possession of the game, even with a much stronger team. Players need help in midfield!
We need to strengthen the midfield! We're losing the possession game against a weaker opponent.
The opposition is controlling the midfield. We should fix this now!
We can keep the ball, but there just aren't enough targets to pass to upfront.
Their defenders comfortably outnumber our attackers. If we have problems scoring, look to support our forwards.
We're losing to this weaker team because of holes in our defence. Maybe we need a player to sit deep and prevent counter-attacks?

pressing.text: We need to win the ball and attack. Let's press our opponent more.
The other team is really strong. If we want to have a chance, we should press them high.
Their team is much weaker. Let's press them high and work on improving our goal difference.
Our high pressing is paying off! Well done!
High pressing might tire our players too early in the game, don't you think?
We're losing key battles in defence. Let's press them high to get the ball back before it reaches our goal.
What a great result! There's no need to press high anymore.
This game is ours to lose! No point in high pressing any more. Let's sit back and rest our players.
Our team is much stronger. We should be able to win this game without having to press high.

offside_trap.text: We're playing an attacking style. Using the offside trap would work well here.
The offside trap is dangerous! If opposing attackers are onside when our defenders push up, we won't be able to catch them.
Their attackers have figured out how to beat our offside trap. What should we do?
Defenders are having troubles executing the offside trap. We should consider changing it!
Our defenders cannot focus enough to efficiently use offside traps.
We conceded some goals as a result of our defender's high line. We should stop using the offside trap tactic.
Our defenders are so confused by the offside trap that the opposition could use it to their advantage.

marking.text: Too many of their players are running over our defence. We should consider zonal marking so our players cover each other.
We're failing to defend every area of the pitch, and some players are left unmarked. We should try zonal marking.
This is a great score! We can boost up defence with man marking!

tackling_cards.text: Let's put in some harder tackles to keep their strikers quiet.
Yellow cards earned early on may lead to a send off. Maybe we should reconsider our tackling style.
If we don't change our tackling style, another player will be sent off.
We are getting too many cards due to our hard tackling style. I hope no one will be sent off.
We are committing too many fouls today. We should maybe think about not tackling so hard.
We shouldn't risk getting more yellow cards! Let's be less physical and avoid committing so many fouls.
There are more than 3 players booked in our line-up. Avoid pressing and hard tackling or someone could be sent off.

approach_state.text: We're already behind. Our best option now is a more offensive approach.
We should consider being more offensive while there's still time. We can do it!
A draw is not enough! Let's attack even more. We need to win this while there's still time.
We are weaker than them. We should focus on defence and protect the draw.
The hard defensive strategy is a great choice. We just need to stay focused until the end.
Playing all offense is leaving us very vulnerable to counter-attacks.
We have the advantage. If we push forward too much, we risk conceding a goal from their counter-attack.
